independent: SPIRALFM1 is an independent Spiralfractal firmware, not a Mycelium update: own brand, own spiral artwork, renamed and retuned presets, regenerated drum one-shots.

brand.notes: The Mycelium name, logo and brand assets belong to Mandalars and are not shipped; only the credit line 'BASED ON MYCELIUM' is shown on the splash.

sound.preset_retune: ANALOG 16-28 and DIGITAL 13-35 renamed and retuned (FM carrier/modulator ratios, envelopes, filter, drive, LFO, level). Mapping table in SPIRALFM1.md.
sound.drums: 15 one-shots regenerated by tools/gen_spiral_drums.py (seed 4711): oscillator kick with pitch envelope and FM, 4-partial metal hat, 4-burst band-passed clap, two-tone snare, FM percussion. No external audio input.
sound.level_trims: firmware/src/spiralfm1_trim.h re-measured after the retune against the base render (BS.1770 gated LUFS, delta-compensated, clamped -40..23 half-dB).
sound.songs: Four 240-bar factory songs retained, retuned with the presets.
